facts: BMC WebUI uploads `.ima`, selects Preserve all Configuration, flashes and checks version.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL but assumes a generic `/Actions/UpdateService.Update` endpoint.

original_test_intent.statement: Upgrade BMC firmware through the supported management update path while preserving configuration, then verify intended version and BMC service health.
must_preserve: BMC target, upgrade direction, preserve-all choice and version verification.
unknowns: Image/version, exact vendor update mechanism, activation reset, preserved fields and rollback.

v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: It allows a generic UpdateService implication; Redfish services expose supported update URIs/actions dynamically and message format can be vendor-specific.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Use only the target BMC's advertised, vendor-approved WebUI or Redfish update mechanism; never invent a fixed action URI.

revision_candidate.test_name: Upgrade BMC Firmware with Configuration Preservation
revision_candidate.purpose: Apply the signed newer BMC image to the exact controller, preserve the approved configuration set, and verify version plus complete management recovery.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact board/BMC hardware revision and current firmware with vendor-supported upgrade path.
revision_candidate.target_scope: One mapped BMC and one signed newer `.ima`; host BIOS/CPLD images are excluded.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Target serial/board/BMC identity, current/target versions, image source/signature/hash/compatibility, advertised update endpoint or WebUI SOP, exhaustive signed preservation matrix and access method for every entry, activation/reset behavior, task polling interval, completion timeout, stall definition, accepted terminal-state/message rule, expected disconnect/reconnect window, stable power, backup/rollback and approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Capture versions, every preservation-matrix entry and all required services; verify image/target; discover supported UpdateService mechanisms or follow WebUI SOP; upload once; poll the returned task at the signed interval until an accepted terminal state or timeout/stall; allow only the approved BMC reset and reconnect window; then exhaustively compare every preservation entry and verify version/services. Any omitted or inaccessible matrix entry prevents PASS.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Alternate recovery/console, stable power and exported configuration available.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Target/image identities and hash/signature; pre/post firmware inventory; complete pre/post export and field-by-field result for every signed preservation entry, including explicit inaccessible/omitted fields; exact method/request or screenshots; task ID/URI, poll timestamps, progress/messages and accepted terminal result; disconnect/reconnect/reset timeline; IPMI/Redfish/WebUI/network/sensor/SEL/user/config recovery.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Correct newer BMC version, task reaches the signed successful terminal state within timeout without stall, every preservation-matrix entry is verified as required with no omission/inaccessibility, and all management services recover; version string or sampled settings are insufficient.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not use generic fixed POST URI, wrong component/image, expose secrets, interrupt power/task, clear logs or retry failed flash automatically.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: BMC owner approves image, preservation, outage and rollback.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Agent may automate an advertised mechanism; console recovery/manual WebUI may be required.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Do not power-cycle during active flash; on terminal failure preserve task data and use vendor recovery/rollback from alternate path.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Identity/compatibility/signature mismatch, unsupported mechanism, missing polling/timeout/stall/terminal rules, unstable power, task error or defined stall/timeout, reconnect-window violation, lost recovery path, inaccessible/omitted preservation entry or failed service/config restoration.

identified_defects: DeepSeek invents a generic UpdateService action path.
reason_for_change: Firmware transport is service- and vendor-advertised; assuming one Redfish action URI can upload to the wrong method or component despite otherwise correct image controls.

new_technical_evidence.title: DMTF Redfish Resource and Schema Guide DSP2046, UpdateService 1.16.0
new_technical_evidence.supports: UpdateService links firmware inventory and exposes supported pull/push mechanisms; push message format can be vendor-specific and clients should follow the service-advertised URI/task model.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Target BMC implementation and vendor `.ima` method must be discovered/approved.

removed_ambiguities: BMC is distinct from BIOS/CPLD; preservation is verified, not assumed.
remaining_blockers: Image, vendor method and recovery approval.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 prevents a fabricated universal Redfish endpoint and expands completion from a version check to preserved configuration plus operational management services.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Initial validator found sampled preserve-all evidence and undefined task timing/terminal semantics. Revalidation confirmed exhaustive preservation, poll/timeout/stall/terminal rules, reconnect window and full management-service recovery.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: No-main row 6 is BMC `.ima` upgrade with Preserve all Configuration and version check.
